summary.text: Khristian Silvis is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 84, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after defeating Justin Rackham in the August 4 Democratic primary.
A U.S. Army veteran, she lists affordability, public education, and support for veterans and first responders as her campaign priorities.

paragraphs.text: Silvis served in the U.S. Army from 2009 to 2012.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a veteran, wife and mother of two who served as a combat medic on a tour in Afghanistan.
She said she later worked alongside members of Congress in New York and West Michigan, connecting people with resources.
Silvis listed three key messages in the survey: affordability and building the middle class, strengthening public education, and supporting veterans and first responders.
She named education and affordable health care as the areas of public policy she is most passionate about.
